assets.name: picture
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one transparent settings-menu icon for Mario Party 6.
Image 1 is the old icon to redesign. Its glossy mobile-game look was rejected. Image 2 is the APPROVED STYLE REFERENCE: the new Brighton/Twila emblem. Match image 2's bold dark warm-brown outlines, narrow cream sticker border, matte painted texture and broad two-or-three-plane shading. Keep the graphical line thickness proportional to image 2. Jaunty early-2000s party-game illustration, with crisp silhouettes and a little asymmetry. No inflatable/toy-plastic look, glossy highlights, large sparkling eyes, open emoji mouth, chrome or photorealism.
Keep the icon's navigation purpose; redraw it in this cohesive family. Exactly one compact emblem on a square, genuine transparent background. Entire silhouette inside the frame with about 10% clear margin on ALL sides. Readable at 40 pixels: simple large forms, no miniature writing, no small decorative clutter. No text, labels, logos, backdrop, floor shadow or checkerboard.
Subject: A slightly jaunty gold picture frame containing a simple blue sky over green treetops and a cream cloud. Small five-point gold star at the top. Thin angular wooden-looking frame, not inflated. Match the sun reference's yellow/orange shadow palette, with brown outlines and a fine cream outer cutout edge. Keep the landscape as broad painted color shapes, no tiny texture.
